audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Darius/Darius/Skill/Darius/Skill/Darius/Darius. Rows 3 and 6 were called Skill while whys[2] says 'his full Q-E combo out-trades your dash poke' and whys[4] says 'his level 6 Guillotine execute makes committing lethal', and the last two rows were given to Darius while whys[5] says 'Your first-item crit and kite finally flip extended trades' and whys[6] says 'your mobility outruns an immobile Darius'.
audit.why: Darius owns every lane phase: Decimate heals off the blade edge on 9s at rank 1, Apprehend pulls from 535, and Noxian Guillotine executes off five Hemorrhage stacks. Yasuo's flip is the first crit item and the mobility gap after it.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through Level 6 read Darius; First item and 2+ items read Yasuo. Matches the packet chart and includes all three flips the mirror audit named. Rows proposed as a matched full+content group.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why and phases[4].why were template filler asserting Yasuo spikes ('your core pattern starts now', 'Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window') on rows that belong to Darius.
audit.why: Level 3 is where his Q-E combo comes online against a Yasuo with one E target and no knockup; level 6 is Noxian Guillotine, true damage that refreshes on a kill, against a Last Breath that needs a target Airborne — which Darius almost never is in a 1v1.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why names the Q-E combo and the Decimate heal; phases[4].why names Guillotine's true damage and refresh alongside the Airborne requirement on Last Breath.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four places built advice on Wind Wall: spikes[2] 'Wind Wall the moment he commits', spikes[3] 'keep Wind Wall for his E-flash and Ghost', late 'Wind Wall on his pull', wants.you[1] 'Wind Wall his Apprehend pull and poke'.
audit.why: Nothing in Darius's kit is a projectile. Decimate is a melee swing, Crippling Strike is an empowered auto, Apprehend is an axe hook pull, Noxian Guillotine is a leap. Wind Wall blocks enemy projectiles and nothing else, so a player banking a 25s wall for the pull loses the pull anyway and has no wall left. The real answers are Apprehend's 26s rank-1 cooldown, Decimate's blade-versus-handle ring, and Crippling Strike's auto-reset wind-up.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall advice replaced with the 26s Apprehend window, holding the dash for his E-flash, and stepping out of the blade ring. Added the Crippling Strike auto-reset tell.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Darius must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His Q-E combo out-trades your dash poke, and Decimate's blade heals him. Keep the wave near your side and farm.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Darius's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is true damage and refreshes on a kill. Last Breath needs him Airborne first, and he rarely is.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crippling Strike is an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: This is your turning point — with Berserker's and first-item crit chance you can kite his Q edge, Wind Wall the moment he commits, and finally win extended trades he used to dominate.
edits.after: This is your turning point — with Berserker's and first-item crit chance you can kite his Q edge, step out of Decimate's blade ring, and finally win extended trades he used to dominate.

edits.before: Once you have crit items and mobility, Darius falls off if he can't reach you; keep Wind Wall for his E-flash and Ghost, dash off his minions, and refuse to stand in Decimate range.
edits.after: Once you have crit items and mobility, Darius falls off if he can't reach you; hold your dash for his E-flash and Ghost, dash off his minions, and refuse to stand in Decimate range.

edits.before: First item onward the lane flips to you: crit Q, Berserker's kite, and Wind Wall on his pull let you fight the outer edge of Decimate and punish him once he can't stick to you.
edits.after: First item onward the lane flips to you: crit Q, Berserker's kite, and the 26s gap on his pull let you fight the outer edge of Decimate and punish him once he can't stick to you.

edits.before: Wind Wall his Apprehend pull and poke
edits.after: Dodge Apprehend — it is 26s at rank 1

notes: This is the same class of error the calibration notes flag, inverted: instead of omitting a Wind Wall interaction, the page invented one against a kit that contains no projectiles at all. Four separate strings told the player to spend their only defensive cooldown on an ability it cannot touch. The mirror audit reached the identical conclusion from the Darius side.
